notes: The bedroom roller shutter now draws its travel vertically - slats descending from the top, an up/down drag, a bottom rail for a grip - instead of borrowing the living-room curtain's sideways motion. Both coverings go full height side by side to give that travel some room. The car's charge only goes amber at 30% and red at 15%, rather than calling half a battery low. A light tile's brightness bar grows on a full-height tile so the space goes to the control you reach for instead of a hole in the middle. A lone Half tile fills its column rather than leaving a dead half-cell under it, and a room label is dropped when it just repeats the row above.
